description: Election Commission - S. Vavananthan was elected as the member of the Eravurpattu Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Eravurpattu Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government body, including the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a vacancy caused by resignation. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of election results for public offices.
